answer_1.quote: We evaluate on GSM8K  and MATH  using Pass@1 accuracy, focusing on complex mathematical reasoning abilities. Code Generation Performance is assessed on HumanEval  and MBPP  using Pass@1 accuracy for natural language to code generation. Chat Models are evaluated using IFEval  loose prompt metric for response controllability and AlpacaEval2  length-controlled win rate (LCWR) against GPT4-Turbo baseline, judged by GPT-4o-2024-08-06.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include solutions to math problems, generated code from natural language descriptions, and chat responses to user prompts.
